title: MCP server catalog entry
description: features/<stack>/mcp/<server>/meta.json — the server's identity, and the marker index_build.py keys the mcp discovery rule on. Its prose lives beside it in server.md and its curated tool intents in tools.json. Which stacks want the server is NOT recorded here: that is what features/<stack>/stack-mcp.json says, by being the file that names it (ADR-0014).

name.description: The server name, matching the directory name and the name stack-mcp.json declares.

package.description: Distribution name for install reference (PyPI, npm). A property of the server, which is why it lives here rather than in one stack's declaration.

description.description: What the server is, for a human reading the catalog. Never injected into an agent file — server.md is what reaches a session.
